We propose the first framework for defining relational program logics for arbitrary monadic effects. The framework is embedded within a relational dependent type theory and is highly expressive.

arxiv-2004-02905.title: Signatures of quantum phase transitions after quenches in quantum-chaotic one-dimensional systems
arxiv-2004-02905.creator: Asmi Haldar, Krishnanand Mallayya, Markus Heyl, Frank Pollmann, Marcos Rigol, Arnab Das
arxiv-2004-02905.description: Abstract Quantum phase transitions are central to our understanding of why matter at very low temperatures can exhibit starkly different properties upon small changes of microscopic parameters. Accurately locating those transitions is challenging experimentally and theoretically. Here we show that the antithetic strategy of forcing systems out of equilibrium via sudden quenches provides a route to locate quantum phase transitions.

arxiv-2203-06386.title: Enabling Multimodal Generation on CLIP via Vision-Language Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2203-06386.creator: Wenliang Dai, Lu Hou, Lifeng Shang, Xin Jiang, Qun Liu, Pascale Fung
arxiv-2203-06386.description: Abstract The recent large-scale vision-language pre-training (VLP) of dual-stream architectures (e.g., CLIP) with a tremendous amount of image-text pair data, has shown its superiority on various multimodal alignment tasks. Despite its success, the resulting models are not capable of multimodal generative tasks due to the weak text encoder.

arxiv-2312-00879.title: Kleinian black holes
arxiv-2312-00879.creator: Damien A. Easson, Max W. Pezzelle
arxiv-2312-00879.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Damien A. Easson, Max W. Pezzelle. We prove there is a unique vacuum solution in split-signature spacetimes with Kleinian S ​ O ​ ( 2 , 1 ) SO(2,1) spherical symmetry. We extend our analysis to accommodate a positive or negative cosmological constant and we prove the Kleinian spherically symmetric solutions to Einstein’s equation are locally isomorphic to the split-signature analogues of Schwarzschild-(Anti)-de Sitter or Nariai spacetimes. Our analysis provides a Kleinian extension of Birkhoff’s theorem to metrics with split-signature.

arxiv-2403-16288.title: Study of Workload Interference with Intelligent Routing on Dragonfly Zhiling Lan’s current affiliation is University of Illinois Chicago, and her current contact is zlan@uic.edu.
arxiv-2403-16288.creator: Yao Kang, Xin Wang, Zhiling Lan
arxiv-2403-16288.description: Abstract Dragonfly interconnect is a crucial network technology for supercomputers. To support exascale systems, network resources are shared such that links and routers are not dedicated to any node pair. While link utilization is increased, workload performance is often offset by network contention. Recently, intelligent routing built on reinforcement learning demonstrates higher network throughput with lower packet latency.

arxiv-2501-17932.title: CIBER 4 th flight fluctuation analysis: Pseudo-power spectrum formalism, improved source masking and validation on mocks
arxiv-2501-17932.creator: Richard M. Feder, James J. Bock, Yun-Ting Cheng, Asantha Cooray, Phillip M. Korngut, Shuji Matsuura, Chi H. Nguyen, Kohji Takimoto, Michael Zemcov, CIBER collaboration
arxiv-2501-17932.description: Abstract Precise, unbiased measurements of extragalactic background anisotropies require careful treatment of systematic effects in fluctuation-based, broad-band intensity mapping measurements. In this paper we detail improvements in methodology for the Cosmic Infrared Background ExpeRiment ( CIBER ), concentrating on flat field errors and source masking errors.

arxiv-2503-04664.title: QE-CONVERSE : An open-source package for the Quantum ESPRESSO distribution to compute non-perturbatively orbital magnetization from first principles, including NMR chemical shifts and EPR parameters
arxiv-2503-04664.creator: S. Fioccola, L. Giacomazzi, D. Ceresoli, N. Richard, A. Hemeryck, L. Martin-Samos
arxiv-2503-04664.description: Abstract Orbital magnetization, a key property arising from the orbital motion of electrons, plays a crucial role in determining the magnetic behavior of molecules and solids. Despite its straightforward calculation in finite systems, the computation in periodic systems poses challenges due to the ill-defined position operator and surface current contributions.

arxiv-2512-18267.title: Well-posedness of the Euler system of gas dynamics
arxiv-2512-18267.creator: Eduard Feireisl, Mária Lukáčová-Medvi d’ ová
arxiv-2512-18267.description: Abstract We propose a new two-step selection criterion applicable to the dissipative measure–valued solutions of the Euler system of gas dynamics. The process consists of a successive maximisation of the entropy production rate and the total energy defect, i.e. maximisation of the turbulent energy.

pmc-11465929.title: Shark fin ECG pattern in a patient with acute ascending aortic dissection
pmc-11465929.creator: Alessio Caccioppola, Filippo Maria Russo, Enrico Molho, Lorenzo Fargione, Alessandro Guareschi, Federico Colombo, Alessandro Jachetti
pmc-11465929.description: The ‘shark-fin’ ECG-sign is a rare electrocardiographic pattern seen in ACS, typically associated with poor prognosis. However, its manifestation in acute aortic syndromes remains largely unexplored. Here, we present a case of a patient diagnosed with Ascending Aortic Dissection, who presented to ED with acute chest pain and shark-fin ECG-pattern.Supplementary InformationThe online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1186/s12245-024-00732-z.

pmc-11472099.title: Surgery, chemoradiotherapy, or chemoradiation plus immunotherapy: Treatment strategies for nonmetastatic anal squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-11472099.creator: Fang He, Mo Chen, Qi-jun Yao, Zhi-min Liu, Yandong Zhao, Fengyun Pei, Jian Zheng, Yuan-hong Gao, Jun Huang
pmc-11472099.description: Highlights•Anal squamous cell cancer patients without distant metastasis who received immunotherapy along with radical concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CRT) experienced significantly higher 3-year PFS, DMFS and LRFS rates than those treated with surgery or CRT alone.•The addition of immunotherapy to CRT for locally advanced anal squamous cell cancer may further enhance disease-related survival benefits, without adding unmanageable toxicity.

pmc-12378789.title: Visualizing and analyzing global knowledge maps and emerging research trends in tumor-derived exosomes using CiteSpace
pmc-12378789.creator: Ruijun Guo, Jiajun Xu, Chunxia Li, Chune Mo, Minglin Ou
pmc-12378789.description: ObjectiveTumor-derived exosomes testing can be effective in diagnosing disease and assisting in the treatment of disease. Our study utilizes bibliometric analysis to identify research hotspots related to tumor-derived exosomes, predict emerging research frontiers and development trends, and offer diverse perspectives for advancing research in this field.

pmc-12391542.title: A stem cell differentiation model reveals two alternative fates in CBFA2T3::GLIS2-driven acute megakaryoblastic leukemia initiation
pmc-12391542.creator: Mohamed R. Shoeb, Dagmar Schinnerl, Lisa E. Shaw, Matthias Farlik, Sabine Strehl, Florian Halbritter, Klaus Fortschegger
pmc-12391542.description: The CBFA2T3::GLIS2 (CG) fusion protein causes aggressive pediatric acute megakaryoblastic leukemia (AMKL). Although dysregulated molecular pathways in AMKL have been identified, their role in early pre-leukemic transformation remains poorly understood. We developed a disease model utilizing genetically modified human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSC) physiologically and conditionally expressing CG.

pmc-12593717.title: A systematic review of literature on substance use in nightlife settings utilizing in situ data collection
pmc-12593717.creator: Renata Glavak-Tkalić, Mike Vuolo, Anja Wertag
pmc-12593717.description: BackgroundNightlife environments, including nightclubs, bars, and entertainment districts, are associated with elevated substance use and related harms. In situ nightlife studies offer an opportunity to capture real-time data on substance use from targeted populations. Despite the growing number of studies, no systematic review has yet been conducted on this topic.

pmc-12753975.title: Investigating the roles of academic emotions in the relationship between agentic engagement and EFL achievement among Chinese undergraduate students
pmc-12753975.creator: Hongwu He
pmc-12753975.description: This study examines the relationships among agentic engagement, academic emotions, and English as a foreign language (EFL) achievement in Chinese undergraduate students, with a focus on variations across grade levels. Utilizing a quantitative design, data were collected from 221 English majors (111 first-year and 110 fourth-year undergraduate students) via questionnaires assessing agentic engagement and academic emotions, alongside English examination scores.

pmc-12771812.title: NLRP3 inflammasome expression in pediatric asthma: sputum-based insights, inflammatory mechanisms, and targeted therapeutic strategies
pmc-12771812.creator: Mohammed AbuBaha, Samia Aldwaik, Bara Abubaha, Anwar Zahran, Dana Sandouka, Kareem Istetieh, Husam Hamshary, Mohammad Abushehadeh, Sarah Saife, Nadeen Sandoqah
pmc-12771812.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Asthma is a common chronic inflammatory disease in children. Pediatric asthma has a wide range of immunologic phenotypes and different treatment responses. Recent data from various studies suggest that the NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome, a cytosolic multiprotein complex, has a central role in innate immunity, may be implicated in pediatric asthma pathogenesis, especially in the neutrophilic corticosteroid-resistant type.

pmc-12812524.title: Hypertriglyceridemic waist and subclinical atherosclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12812524.creator: Wei Xiong, Hua Fan, Yao You, Qingwen Yu, Ziyi Xin, Ting Tang, Xiyun Rao, Lanlan Feng, Yongmin Shi, Xuhan Tong, Jiake Tang, Xinyan Fu, Xingwei Zhang, Mingwei Wang, Hangzhou Luo
pmc-12812524.description: BackgroundAtherosclerosis is a chronic, progressive inflammatory disease with a long asymptomatic period. Disease progression can eventually lead to acute cardiovascular events, such as myocardial infarction, unstable angina, and sudden cardiac death. Hypertriglyceridemic waist (HTGW) has received much attention recently as a cheap and non-invasive test.

pmc-12972653.title: Observations of the developmental stages of Coquillettidia perturbans (Diptera: Culicidae) with special reference to the pupal trumpets
pmc-12972653.creator: Nicholas Benton, Fiona F Hunter
pmc-12972653.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Coquillettidia perturbans (Walker) is a North American mosquito species of medical and veterinary importance that has been implicated as a vector of eastern equine encephalitis virus. perturbans possess highly specialized respiratory appendages that enable them to respire from air vesicles in the hollow roots and shoots of emergent aquatic vegetation, which means that the larval and pupal stages have remained largely understudied. perturbans larvae, pupae, and adults were studied under laboratory conditions in an attempt to establish a laboratory colony.

pmc-13220742.title: Testing Longitudinal Measurement Invariance of the Dutch PSS-10, MBI-ES, and PANAS in a Bimonthly 6-Month Panel
pmc-13220742.creator: Justine Van de Velde, Bert Weijters, Katia Levecque
pmc-13220742.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Monitoring teacher well-being over time is essential in both research and practice to understand changes, evaluate interventions, and support occupational health. This study examines the longitudinal measurement invariance of the Dutch versions of three commonly used scales related to well-being: the Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10), the Emotional Exhaustion subscale of the Maslach Burnout Inventory (MBI), and the Positive and Negative Affect Schedule (PANAS).

pmc-13324510.title: Supporting change in a complex reality: a qualitative study of specialist nurses’ perceptions of counselling patients at risk of type 2 diabetes
pmc-13324510.creator: Åsa Carlsund, Åsa Hörnsten, Fatima Hoosen, Stephen Amoah, Julia Otten

pmc-13354553.title: Effect of a spore-based Mannheimia haemolytica vaccine on immune responses and respiratory microbiota in sheep
pmc-13354553.creator: Muhammed Salah Uddin, José Ortiz Guluarte, Timothy D. Schwinghamer, Daniel R. Barreda, Tim A. McAllister, Le Luo Guan, Trevor W. Alexander
pmc-13354553.description: Mannheimia haemolytica is an opportunistic pathogen associated with respiratory disease in ruminants. Current vaccines provide incomplete protection, highlighting the need for improved immunization strategies. In this study, a mucosal vaccine was developed using Bacillus subtilis spores as an adjuvant and evaluated for its effects on immune responses and respiratory microbiota in sheep.

pmc-13463796.title: Workflow and dosimetric results for direct-to-unit single-fraction adaptive lung SBRT delivered on the ONE-STOP prospective pilot clinical trial
pmc-13463796.creator: Farnoush Forghani, Thomas R Mazur, Joshua P Schiff, Daniel Hong, Alden D'Souza, Ryan Mueller, Jessica Hamilton, Jennifer Harris, Tami Jamruk, Jessica Hilliard, Robbie Beckert, Amit Bhatt, Gregory R Vlacich, Clifford G Robinson, Pamela P Samson, Eric Laugeman
pmc-13463796.description: BackgroundDirect-to-unit (DTU) workflows coupled with online adaptive radiation therapy can streamline stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) by eliminating conventional simulation and prolonged treatment planning, thereby reducing treatment burden while maintaining high dosimetric quality.AimTo evaluate the feasibility and dosimetric robustness of a CBCT-guided DTU workflow for single-fraction lung SBRT.

pmc-13517741.title: Profile Likelihood and Baseline Sensitivity Diagnostics for Digitized Radiation Sensor Decay Datasets
pmc-13517741.creator: Victor V. Golovko
pmc-13517741.description: Accurate interpretation of radiation sensor decay data is important for environmental monitoring, site remediation, radiation metrology, detector quality assurance, and nuclear data evaluation. When the original gamma spectrometry records are unavailable, a published decay plot may be the only source that can be reanalyzed independently.
